아무튼서로알아들었으면된거아닌가요 — the design system, as shipped.

Foundations and the brand identity on this row; the screens and the rules below. Everything here matches src/app/globals.css and the Figma file — if the three disagree, the CSS is right.
The live console was deliberately NOT redesigned. It was the only surface that had been properly designed, and the rest was made consistent with it.
